raw_record.question_text:
A group of scientists wished to learn about the energy efficiency of different modes of locomotion. They studied the literature that was based on accurate measurements and produced this graph based on the data they analyzed.
According to the graph, which mode of locomotion is the least energy-efficient?
raw_record.standard_answer: Running is the least energy-efficient means of locomotion.

method.method_draft: First describe the graph: it plots energy cost versus body mass, with separate labeled lines for flying, swimming, and running. Then compare the vertical positions of the locomotion lines because the y-axis measures energy cost. Identify the mode whose line is highest, since that mode uses the most energy per kg per meter. The running line is the highest-cost locomotion mode in the graph, so conclude that running is least energy-efficient.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一张对数坐标图，横轴标为体重 Body mass (g) (log scale)，纵轴标为能量成本 Energy cost (cal/kg·m) (log scale)。图中分别有标注为 Flying、Swimming 和 Running 的斜线，表示不同运动方式的能量成本随体重变化的关系。推理：纵轴表示能量成本，所以线在图中越高，代表每千克每米消耗的能量越多，也就是能量效率越低。比较这些标注线的位置，Running 对应的线表示最高的能量成本，因此它是最不节能的运动方式。

method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一张双对数坐标图，横轴标为 Body mass (g) (log scale)，表示体重，单位是克；纵轴标为 Energy cost (cal/kg·m) log scale，表示单位质量移动单位距离的能量消耗。图中有三条标注的运动方式曲线：Flying、Swimming 和 Running。纵轴的主要刻度包括约 10^-1、1、10、100、1000 等数量级。Flying 线大致在较小体重范围内，从约几十 cal/kg·m 降到约几 cal/kg·m；Swimming 线较低，大致从几 cal/kg·m 降到约 0.1 到 1 cal/kg·m；Running 线在其对应体重范围内大致从几十 cal/kg·m 降到约 0.1 cal/kg·m，并且相对于其他可比曲线整体处在较高能量成本位置。推理：能量效率与能量成本相反，移动同样距离所需的能量成本越高，效率越低。根据图中各模式的能量成本数值比较，Running 对应的能量成本最高，因此它是最不节能的运动方式。
